restaurantName: Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu (Phra Nakhon)
address: 115/5 Dinso Road, Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok, 10200, Thailand
bio: The tempting scent of sizzling pork greets you at this vibrant restaurant by chef Andy Yang. Their signature dish features nicely char-grilled pork loin slices atop savoury Pad Thai. Another recommendation is the Pad Thai with fresh prawns, stir-fried in their shell for sweet, delicious meat. For top-notch Pad Thai and skilled wok-based cooking at a fair price, this is your spot....
pageTitle: Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu (Phra Nakhon)
